review.message_zh: Gassco对应Troll来源明确为Gas production field（气田/生产设施），分析却称Troll管道维护；另一条Other公告也没有管道类型证据。该简报把LNG Canada管道项目类别串给Troll，事实类别复核未通过；原结果及方向完整保留。
review.message_en: The cited Gassco Troll notice is a gas production field, while the brief calls it pipeline maintenance. The other notice is Other and supplies no pipeline classification. The brief transfers a pipeline class from the LNG Canada project to Troll and fails source-entity review; its original result and direction are preserved.
